title: MY NEW TAVELO GROW BUILD

takeaways.text: Maxxis Rambler 50 mm tires on 32 mm-internal wheels still left generous room at the rear chainstays and fork for mud; he cites 55–57 mm as possible. 1× only, here with a 50T ring and 10–46 cassette.
The frame and bar, bought through Tavelo's Australian channel, shipped from China and arrived in about a week (October 2026).
His complete build including shop assembly cost about AUD 7,200–7,300 with SRAM Force XPLR, aftermarket carbon wheels and Maxxis tires; the first ride was trouble-free.

disclosure: Owner walkthrough of a self-bought size-490 Tavelo Grow ordered through Tavelo's Australian channel and built by a local shop; no sponsorship is stated.
summary: Australian owner's walkthrough of a medium Tavelo Grow build with sourcing, delivery times and total cost.
